# Question review

Getting a question from a draft to the bank: views with counts, a queue, bulk actions with a dry run, one question at a time with its history, and a reason for every return.

[ReviewRail](#reviewrail) · [ReviewQueue](#reviewqueue) · [ReviewBar](#reviewbar) · [ReviewPanel](#reviewpanel) · [ReviewHistory](#reviewhistory) · [ReviewReasonDialog](#reviewreasondialog)

### ReviewRail

The views of the review as a list with counts: what waits for you, every question, one view per stage (drafts, waiting, pre-approved, approved, returned, trash) and the questions that have waited too long.

```ts
import { ReviewRail } from '@/contest/components/ReviewRail'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `counts` *(required)* | `Record<ReviewView, number>` |  | How many questions are in each view. See `reviewCounts`. |
| `value` *(required)* | `ReviewView` |  | The open view. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(view: ReviewView) => void` |  | Called with the view that was chosen. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ReviewRail counts={reviewCounts(questions, ctx)} value={view} onChange={setView} />
```

- Open the page on "Waiting for you": it is the work this person can do now. Each stage also has a dot colour, but the names carry the meaning.

### ReviewQueue

The questions of one view as a list to work through: a tick box, the question, its level, topic, writer, source trust, how many things to check and how long it has waited (amber when too long). Select-all sits in the header.

```ts
import { ReviewQueue } from '@/contest/components/ReviewQueue'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The questions of the view, in the order to show them. |
| `keys` *(required)* | `Record<string, AnswerKey>` |  | The answer keys, for the "to check" count. |
| `onSelect` *(required)* | `(question: Question) => void` |  | Called when a question is opened. |
| `checked` *(required)* | `string[]` |  | Ids ticked for a bulk action. |
| `onCheckedChange` *(required)* | `(ids: string[]) => void` |  | Called with the new list of ticked ids. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. Waiting time is worked out from it. |
| `selectedId` | `string \| null` |  | The question that is open. |
| `policy` | `ReviewPolicy` | `DEFAULT_POLICY` | The rules of the review: after how many days a waiting question is stale. |
| `empty` | `string` | `'Nothing here.'` | Shown when the list is empty. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ReviewQueue questions={shown} keys={keys} selectedId={id} onSelect={(q) => setId(q.id)} checked={ticked} onCheckedChange={setTicked} now={now} />
```

- J and K move to the next and the previous question, X ticks the open one, while nobody is typing.

### ReviewBar

The bar for acting on many questions at once. Each button says how many of the ticked questions it will change, and the line under it says why the others are left out, so nothing is skipped in silence. A button appears only for actions that apply to at least one ticked question.

```ts
import { ReviewBar } from '@/contest/components/ReviewBar'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The questions that are ticked. The bar shows nothing when there are none. |
| `keys` *(required)* | `Record<string, AnswerKey>` |  | The answer keys, to tell whether a draft is ready to send. |
| `actor` *(required)* | `string` |  | Who is acting. Nobody approves their own question. |
| `onAction` *(required)* | `(action: ReviewAction, ids: string[]) => void` |  | Called with the action and the ids it can be done to. The ones that cannot are left out. |
| `onClear` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the selection is cleared. |
| `policy` | `ReviewPolicy` | `DEFAULT_POLICY` | The rules of the review. |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  | Switches the buttons off while a change is being saved. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ReviewBar selected={ticked} keys={keys} actor="Ada" onAction={(action, ids) => review(action, ids)} onClear={() => setTicked([])} />
```

- The numbers come from `bulkPlan`, a dry run of the same rules the backend applies. A return or a withdrawal needs a reason: ask for it in `onAction` (see `ReviewReasonDialog`).

### ReviewPanel

One question for a reviewer: where it is in the review and for how long, the question with the right answer marked, the things to check, the reason it was returned, the buttons for what this person can do (with the reason shown when they cannot), and the history.

```ts
import { ReviewPanel } from '@/contest/components/ReviewPanel'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question` *(required)* | `Question` |  | The question under review. |
| `actor` *(required)* | `string` |  | Who is acting. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `onAction` *(required)* | `(action: ReviewAction) => void` |  | Called with the action the person chose. A return or a withdrawal still needs a reason: ask for it in the handler. |
| `answerKey` | `AnswerKey \| null` |  | The answer key: the reviewer sees what is right. |
| `policy` | `ReviewPolicy` | `DEFAULT_POLICY` | The rules of the review. |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  | Switches the buttons off while a change is being saved. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ReviewPanel question={q} answerKey={keys[q.id]} actor="Ada" now={now} onAction={(action) => ask(action, [q.id])} />
```

- A takes the main step (pre-approve, approve, send for review) and R returns the question, while nobody is typing.
- A button that is off says why in a line under the buttons: "You wrote this question. Someone else has to pre-approve it."

### ReviewHistory

What happened to a question, newest first: who did what, when, and the reason when they gave one.

```ts
import { ReviewHistory } from '@/contest/components/ReviewHistory'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `events` *(required)* | `ReviewEvent[]` |  | The events of a question: `question.review.history`. |
| `now` | `Date` |  | Replaces the clock for "3 days ago", for tests and demos. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ReviewHistory events={question.review?.history ?? []} />
```

### ReviewReasonDialog

Asks why, before a question is returned or withdrawn. The reason goes to the writer, so the button stays off until it is at least a few words. Quick reasons add a common sentence with one tap.

```ts
import { ReviewReasonDialog } from '@/contest/components/ReviewReasonDialog'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` *(required)* | `ReviewAction \| null` |  | The action that needs a reason, or null to close the dialog. |
| `count` *(required)* | `number` |  | How many questions it is for. |
| `onConfirm` *(required)* | `(note: string) => void` |  | Called with the reason when the person confirms. |
| `onCancel` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the dialog is cancelled. |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner on the button. |

```tsx
<ReviewReasonDialog action={asking?.action ?? null} count={asking?.ids.length ?? 0} onCancel={() => setAsking(null)} onConfirm={(note) => run(asking!.action, asking!.ids, note)} />
```
